newsitem.title: USA: ADVO says board approves buyback program.
newsitem.headline: ADVO says board approves buyback program.

text.p: ADVO Inc said on Wednesday that its directors had approved the purchase of up to two million shares of its own common stock within the next 12 months, either in the open market, in private transactions, or otherwise, for corporate purposes.
ADVO currently has 24,310,113 outstanding shares of common stock, the company said in a statement.
It added that it is buying back stock because it believes the stock is undervalued at current market prices and thus a good investment.
ADVO also said it had no specific plans regarding the use of the shares to be purchased.
ADVO is a direct mail marketing services company with annual revenues of almost $1 billion, the company said.
